fact: The ACE consortium lists Freetown, Sierra Leone as an ACE landing station and says ACE is the first international submarine cable to land in Sierra Leone, in service since 15 December 2012 (page undated; in-service date is the consortium's).

The Conversation Africa (interview) says Sierra Leone, like Liberia, has only one fibre optic cable coming into the country, so its internet traffic stops when that cable breaks; the cable is not named.
